testCase.name: [dev] S10 Hospital retention, seeded: no recording from D-4 or earlier and no notes row archived over 36 h ago is listed; typed dictation is listed after 18 h and kept before it

descriptionHtml:
要人拍板 D6 · P1 · Daniela

转录 / 保留时长和 UAT 3.6 不一致：归档 48 小时（不是 36）、养老院保留 3 次访视（不是 2 次）、「Earlier sessions」和「Most Recent」不带日期、快速口述框永不过期、保留时长写死在代码里（是不是要做成配置）

同一个问题的其他用例（只算一次）：TC-16/S11, TC-16/S14, TC-16/S23, TC-16/S27, OAT-04/S19, TC-11/S28, TC-04/S10

思路 / Approach · TC-16 Prior Encounter Transcripts · S10 「医院保留，seed 出来的：不列出 D-4 或更早的录音，不列出存档超过 36 h 的记录行；打字的口述 18 h 后列出来，18 h 之前留着」 Hospital retention, seeded: no recording from D-4 or earlier and no notes row archived over 36 h ago is listed; typed dictation is listed after 18 h and kept before it

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U6a Hospital, the part of 'today and yesterday only' that holds under every reading of Q1, Q10 and Q12: on server day D, no bedside recording from D-4 or earlier is listed (archived as '(prior)' or left …（UAT 3.6；TFA-92594 AC 2；UAT TC-13 (day-2 reopen)）
  • U6b Hospital edges that depend on Q1 (calendar day vs hour windows: a D-2 or D-3 recording), Q10 (36 h vs 54 h in all for typed dictation: a row archived 35 h ago) and Q12 (prototype per-stay history vs …（UAT 3.6；UAT 3.7；TFA-92594 AC 1；TFA-92594 AC 2）
  • U1 Each encounter's transcript is saved automatically, with no manual step. After 2+ visits, the earlier visit's transcript is there for reference without re-dictating.（UAT TC-16；TFA-92594 How it works 1；TFA-92594 AC 2）

测试设计方法：边界值（boundary） — 卡在规则的边上（刚好到点 / 过一分钟、空、最长、最多）看行为在哪一边变。

Given Server day D on the local stack. {hospitalPatient}: three rounding.update writes with transcriptDate D-4 'QA16-RET-D4', D-1 'QA16-RET-D1', then D 'QA16-RET-D0', so the server itself builds '<D-4> (prior)' and '<D-1> (prior)'; a '<Mon D, 55 h ago> · Encounter notes' row 'QA16-RET-37H' with archivedAt = now−37 h; …

When Open the Hospital list (AppLayout ContextLifecycle runs rounding:applyLifecycle with the server's Date.now()), then patient 1's Encounter tab: look without opening anything, open '<D-1> (prior)', open the '<19 h ago> · Encounter notes' row. Then patient 2's Encounter tab

Then Patient 1 lists only '<D-1> (prior)', '<19 h ago> · Encounter notes' and 'Most Recent': no '<D-4> (prior)', no 37 h notes row, and so no 'Earlier sessions' fold. The 19 h note has left the working box and opens to its text. Patient 2 lists no 'Most Recent' (the D-5 recording is gone) and its 17 h note is still in the working box. …

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：From UAT 3.6 Hospital lines and TFA-92594 AC 2, using only the part that holds under every reading of Q1, Q10 and Q12 (U6a). 37 h is one hour past 36 h: outside the 3.6 reading (36 h after it becomes yesterday's transcript) and the 3.7 reading (36 h in all), and its label day is at least the day before yesterday. …

在哪跑：dev 单元 U17；测试方法 AGENT · 浏览器 agent；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（blocked）

S10 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-16.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条；要拍板的人：Daniela。

问题分类：要人拍板（Daniela） · 环境 dev · 票 TFA-92594 ready for qa

医院病人的既往转录里，4 天前的录音和归档超过 36 小时的笔记还在，被合成没有日期的「Earlier sessions」行，不是只显示今天和昨天。

For a Hospital patient, recordings from 4 or more days ago and notes archived over 36 h ago are still listed, grouped into undated 'Earlier sessions' rows, instead of only today and yesterday.

依据：Allure 1f7371f6. Ledger #17 U17: 'Fail vs UAT 3.6 — by design, needs Daniela'. '(prior)' rows have no archivedAt (transcriptArchive.ts:92-95, prototype per-stay policy 4204450), and encounterArchive expires at 48 h. Dev report §3 row 1. TC-16 Q1/Q10/Q12 are open (prototype vs AC 2). The TFA-94699 table (in progress) says 36 h.

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：AGENT · 浏览器 agent；辅助：TIME · 时间 / 老化（改时钟） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。

Recorded (evidence only):

  • s10-h2-collapsed.md: (U6b / Q1: is a D-2 recording listed?) pass: "Mon Oct 12 2026 (prior)" present
  • s10-h2-collapsed.md: (U6b / Q10: is a notes row archived 35 h ago listed?) pass: "Mon Oct 12 2026 · Encounter notes" present
  • s10-h2-collapsed.md: (Q8: is the 17 h note already listed as a row?) fail: no match for /button "(?:Jan|Feb|Mar|Apr|May|Jun|Jul|Aug|Sep|Oct|Nov|Dec) \d{1,2} · Encounter notes/i

Plan: unit U17 (#17, ready-for-qa, ui-only) — Prior transcripts: dated rows and retention. Same panel, view only; both are about which day a row shows and keeps. Distinct patients; S27's key is renamed. Runs together with TC-16/S27.

Checked by Quinn's runner (ledger.md #17, U17; checked: yes): Fail vs UAT 3.6 — by design, needs Daniela — Recorded '(prior)' transcript rows have no archivedAt by design (convex/lib/transcriptArchive.ts:92-95, prototype per-stay policy, commit 4204450) and archived encounter rows expire at 48 h (lifecycle.ts encounterArchive), so a 37 h row and a 4-day '(prior)' row stay; >4 sessions are then grouped as 'Earlier sessions' (transcriptHistory.ts:39-79) and the dated rows can't be opened. UAT 3.6 / OAT-04: prior transcripts today+yesterday only, 36 h. S27: undated 'Most Recent' (Q5, known). Cluster R1 (transcript retention).
